entities.summary: Soledad Ortega Spottorno was a Spanish intellectual. The daughter of the philosopher José Ortega y Gasset and Rosa Spottorno Topete, she was the driving force behind a large number of cultural projects, including the creation of the José Ortega y Gasset Foundation.
